Candidate.description:
A knowledge item candidate extracted from raw input.

Candidates are the primary output of the extraction stage. Each candidate may progress through triage to become a committed knowledge item, or be discarded as a duplicate.

suggested_tags.description: Suggested categorisation tags. Always expected from the extraction prompt — an absent field is a parse error.

KnowledgeKind.description: The classification of a knowledge item.

RelationHint.description:
An intra-batch relation hint between two candidates by index.

Emitted by the extraction agent to indicate that one candidate is derived from another within the same batch.

hint_type.description: The type of relation hinted at.

source_index.description: Index of the source candidate in the batch.

target_index.description: Index of the target candidate in the batch.

RelationHintType.description:
The type of an intra-batch relation hint emitted by the extraction agent.

Currently a single variant; the enum exists as an extension point for future hint types.

SuggestedReference.description:
A suggested external reference for a candidate.

The `reference_type` is a free string — the LLM may produce values outside the expected set. Validation and mapping to [`ReferenceKind`] happens during triage, not extraction.

[`ReferenceKind`]: crate::ReferenceKind

description: Extracted knowledge items and optional intra-batch relationship hints.

candidates.description: Knowledge items extracted from the input. Each candidate should be atomic (one claim per item) and self-contained. Return an empty array if the input contains no extractable knowledge.

relation_hints.description: Derivation relationships between candidates in this batch. Only include when one candidate is genuinely derived from another. Optional — omit or return an empty array when no intra-batch relationships exist.
